ast.name: text
ast.source: Grab your GitHub repository's HTTPS or SSH url and paste it into the settings here. If you're not authenticated, the first sync with this plugin should prompt you to authenticate. If you've already setup SSH on your device with GitHub, you won't need to authenticate - just paste your repo's SSH url into the settings here.
ast.target: 获取您的 GitHub 仓库的 HTTPS 或 SSH URL，并将其粘贴到此处的设置中。如果您未进行身份验证，首次使用此插件同步时会提示您进行身份验证。如果您已在设备上使用 GitHub 设置了 SSH，则无需进行身份验证——只需将仓库的 SSH URL 粘贴到此处设置中即可。
